description: This file is the entry point for a React-based web application. It imports core React libraries, CSS styles, and the main App component, then renders the App component inside the DOM element with id 'root' using ReactDOM's createRoot API.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering into a specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root.
